subject: Finalize RSVP cadence & tracking for 'Serving LLMs: Cost, Latency & Reliability' webinar
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial plan: RSVP cadence + tracking for 'Serving LLMs' webinar

Team —

We need to lock the RSVP reminder cadence and tracking schema for the webinar on March 9. Goals: 1) maximize relevant RSVPs from mid-market platform teams, 2) ensure clean attribution to HubSpot campaign, and 3) avoid over-emailing APAC audiences because of timezone.

Draft ask:
- Target segments: product/platform engineers (primary), engineering managers (secondary). See attached target-segments-q1.csv for proposed HubSpot lists.
- Cadence proposal (staggered):
  * Initial invite (T-28 days) — long-form, tech-focused agenda + speakers.
  * Reminder 1 (T-14 days) — short 2-line reminder + CTA.
  * Reminder 2 (T-4 days) — urgency + testimonial stat.
  * Day-of (T-2 hours) — calendar link + dial-in.
  * Post-webinar follow-up (T+1 day) — recording + next steps.

Tracking: we should standardize UTM tags and map them to HubSpot Campaign HS-45321. See tracking-link-map-utm.xlsx. Proposed UTM pattern: utm_source=email&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=serving-llms-2027&utm_content={segment}_{variant}.

A/B tests: subject line timing (morning vs. lunchtime), and two different reminder copy variants for Reminder 2.

Please review and add the copy you want to test. Heather at EventsQuad will manage sends for paid lists — CCed below for vendor coordination once we finalize.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial plan: RSVP cadence + tracking for 'Serving LLMs' webinar

Agree with the staggered cadence. A couple of edits from content side:
- Initial invite: lead with a short customer use-case (30–40 words) that highlights cost savings from batching + cache. Keeps attention for engineers.
- Reminder 2 (T-4): add a short bulleted list of 3 takeaways — helps conversions.

I've updated rsvp-email-snippets-v2.docx with copy variants for A/B:
- Variant A: Technical POV (open with perf numbers)
- Variant B: Business POV (open with cost/units saved)

Also flag: APAC segment should receive the initial invite at 17:00 PT / 09:00 SGT two days later (so it doesn't go out at midnight local). Jordan, can you confirm send windows for APAC?

Marissa
Senior Demand Gen Manager
Redwood Inference

> Also flag: APAC segment should receive the initial invite at 17:00 PT / 09:00 SGT two days later (so it doesn't go out at midnight local). Jordan, can you confirm send windows for APAC?

We can do staggered send windows. Proposed final schedule:
- NA audience: sends at 09:00 PT (local mornings) for initial + Reminder 1; reminders follow same time relative to event.
- EMEA: 10:30 PT / 18:30 CET for initial, unless EMEA list size is under 400 then push to 08:00 PT.
- APAC: as Marissa suggested, schedule initial + Reminder 1 at 17:00 PT (09:00 SGT next day).

I'm going to build the send groups in HubSpot and attach the list names to the tracking spreadsheet. Also will add timezone column to target-segments-q1.csv.

Jordan
Growth Ops

Subject: Finalized: RSVP cadence, copy variants, and tracking map (action items)

Thanks everyone — final decisions below and action items.

Decisions: 
- Cadence: initial (T-28), reminder1 (T-14), reminder2 (T-4), day-of (T-2h), post (T+1).
- Copy variants: A (Technical) and B (Business) approved. See rsvp-email-snippets-v2.docx.
- UTM pattern locked: utm_source=email&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=serving-llms-2027&utm_content={segment}_{variant}. EventsQuad will use evq_cid for paid mappings.
- APAC schedule approved as proposed.

Action items (owner -> due):
- Jordan: finalize HubSpot lists + timezone columns and upload final CSV to Drive (due 2027-02-19).
- Marissa: confirm Variant A/B subject lines and send creative to EventsQuad (due 2027-02-19).
- Heather / EventsQuad: seed/warm paid lists and confirm billing estimate (due 2027-02-20).
- Laura: create a 1-pager for SDRs with qualifying questions + calendar booking copy (due 2027-02-22).

Attachments: target-segments-q1.csv, rsvp-email-snippets-v2.docx, tracking-link-map-utm.xlsx.

If anyone needs a different send window for a specific list, flag it in the Drive doc today. Otherwise we'll move to production on 19 Feb.

Marcus
